params.body:
`composer audit --locked` fails the "Dependency audits" job on every pull request since two Symfony advisories landed for versions in the lock file.

| Package | From | To | Advisory |
|---|---|---|---|
| symfony/http-foundation | 8.1.4 | 8.1.9 | CVE-2026-108082, ReDoS in `HeaderUtils::split()` through the `Cache-Control` request header. Reachable by anyone who can send a request. |
| symfony/yaml | 8.1.2 | 8.1.9 | CVE-2026-109413, unbounded recursion in the inline lexer. Only `laravel/roster`, a dev tool, pulls it in. |

`symfony/polyfill-mbstring` and `symfony/polyfill-php80` move to 1.43.0 as their dependencies. Only `composer.lock` changes.

## Checked

- `composer audit --locked`: no advisories.
- Full suite on MariaDB 10.11: 1380 tests, the same 21 failures as on `main` locally (Chrome printing without `node_modules`, Vite manifest, build stamp, report PDFs), none new.

Unblocks the audit on #260.
params.title: Symfony http-foundation and yaml past two security advisories
